results.title: Philippines summons China's envoy over remarks conveying 'threat' - Reuters
results.snippet: MANILA, Oct 19 (Reuters) - The Philippine foreign ministry on Monday summoned China's ambassador to express its "serious concern and strong ​objection" about remarks by the envoy that it said conveyed ‌a threat of the use of force. Ambassador Jing Quan told media last week that China "may easily win" in a confrontation with the Philippines, but Beijing would not use force ​because "we love peace".
